headline: Walang Pasok: Manila and Luzon LGUs Announce Class Suspensions Amid Habagat Rains
seoTitle: Walang Pasok Aug. 17: Manila, Luzon LGU Updates | FMB News
seoDescription: Local governments announced class suspensions as Habagat rains affected parts of Luzon on August 17, 2026.
deck: Local suspension orders expanded as monsoon rains continued, with families advised to rely on their own LGU and school for the final applicable notice.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The August 17 FMB News morning brief reported class suspensions in Manila and several Luzon localities as Southwest Monsoon rains continued.

Because suspension coverage can change by school level and locality, FMB News is not treating the package's entire locality list as independently verified. Students and parents should follow the latest announcement from their LGU or school.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The morning brief also cited PAGASA rainfall advisories for parts of western Luzon as the Habagat continued to influence weather conditions.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Class-suspension information is time-sensitive and directly affects travel and safety decisions, so locality-specific claims should be checked against the issuing authority.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Monitor PAGASA bulletins and official LGU or school announcements for additions, extensions or resumptions.
